name: Žemaitukai
description:
Lithuanian music group Žemaitukai are returning to Oslo and, for the second time, inviting you to an unforgettable evening at Vulkan Arena!

Žemaitukai are one of the most popular Lithuanian music groups, combining pop, country and modern Lithuanian sounds. Their music is full of energy, emotion and songs that the whole audience can sing along to.

After their successful first Sold Out performance in Oslo, Žemaitukai are coming back to Vulkan Arena with even more music, energy and an unforgettable concert atmosphere.

Expect a night filled with live music, fan-favourite songs, dancing, good vibes and an authentic Lithuanian atmosphere in the heart of Oslo!

Lithuanian music. Live performance. Unforgettable atmosphere.
